about: Notable TV, film and music moments by date (MM-DD).

items.text: Top of the Pops is broadcast for the first time.
Desert Island Discs is broadcast for the first time.
The Beatles play their last public performance, on the roof of Apple Corps in London.
The Beatles appear on The Ed Sullivan Show, watched by more than 70 million Americans.
The first episode of EastEnders is broadcast.
The film version of The Sound of Music premieres in New York.
The Beatles release their first album, Please Please Me, in the UK.
ABBA win the Eurovision Song Contest in Brighton with “Waterloo”.
Game of Thrones premieres on HBO.
The first series of Strictly Come Dancing begins on BBC One.
The first Academy Awards ceremony is held in Hollywood.
Star Wars opens in American cinemas.
E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial is released in the United States.
Jurassic Park is released in the United States.
Jaws opens in American cinemas, creating the summer blockbuster.
Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone is published in the UK.
Back to the Future is released in the United States.
The Spice Girls release their debut single, “Wannabe”, in the UK.
Live Aid is held at Wembley Stadium and in Philadelphia.
MTV launches with “Video Killed the Radio Star” by The Buggles.
Oasis play the first of two record-breaking nights at Knebworth.
The Woodstock festival begins in New York State.
The Great British Bake Off is broadcast for the first time.
Who Wants to Be a Millionaire? is first shown on ITV.
The first episode of Only Fools and Horses is broadcast.
The first Glastonbury Festival is held at Worthy Farm in Somerset.
The first episode of Friends is broadcast in the United States.
The Beatles release Abbey Road.
The first James Bond film, Dr. No, premieres in London, and The Beatles release “Love Me Do”.
Blue Peter is broadcast for the first time.
Queen release “Bohemian Rhapsody” as a single.
The BBC Television Service begins regular broadcasts from Alexandra Palace.
Channel 4 launches. Its first programme is Countdown.
Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature film, is released in the United States.
The first episode of Doctor Who is broadcast.
Band Aid record “Do They Know It's Christmas?” in London.
The first episode of Coronation Street is broadcast.
The Simpsons airs its first full-length episode.
